rows.grounds: locative of compound bindu-cakra; location of ritual action
locative plural of compound pūrva-ādi-catur-diś; specifies directional locations

items.question: In which specific locations within the bindu-circle is ritual satisfaction to be directed?
premises: The bindu-circle is named as the locus of ritual satisfaction.
The four directions beginning with east are specified as locations.
The middle is specified as an additional location.
items.inference: Ritual satisfaction is to be directed within the bindu-circle at the four directions beginning with east and at the middle.
uncertainties: The verb governing the satisfaction is carried over from the preceding verse.
items.plain_english: And in the bindu-circle, in the four directions beginning with the east, and in the middle.
